## Today

The behaviour described as missing is already present. `HomeViewModel`
(`app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/home/HomeViewModel.kt`)
injects `SensorPermissionManager`, sets
`currentSensorPermissionReminderVisible` from
`sensorPermissionManager.isGranted()` at construction, and exposes
`onSensorPermissionReminderClicked()`, which calls
`sensorPermissionManager.requestAgain()`: a `Resolved` outcome updates
the reminder's visibility from the resolved state, and a
`RedirectedToSettings` outcome (returned when
`SensorPermissionManager.requestAgain()` finds the system no longer
offers the prompt and calls `system.openAppSettings()`) leaves it
unchanged. `HomeUiState` carries `sensorPermissionReminderVisible`.
`HomeScreen.kt` reads `WatchStringResources.Permission.reminder` and
`WatchStringResources.Permission.action` and renders both, gated by
`showsSensorPermissionReminder(uiState)`, with the action's click
bound to `viewModel.onSensorPermissionReminderClicked()`.
